name: TelematicsAlertTriage
tagline: Turn telematics and dash-cam alerts into coaching – prioritised, tracked and scored.
description: A complete fleet-safety app in one PCF control: speeding, harsh braking, idling, seatbelt, phone use, following distance and collision events get a severity, a priority and a next step; safety coaches triage the queue, assign and record coaching with acknowledgements, dismiss false positives with a reason or escalate, and every driver gets a safety score with a 14-day trend.
features: Severity from speed over the limit, g-force and idling time (or from your data)
Priority with repeat-offender, video, overdue and age factors
Driver safety score 0–100 with bands A–D and trend
Coaching workflow with coach, due date, method, note and acknowledgement rules
Critical events only dismissable by a safety manager
Bulk actions with per-row rule checks, undo, coaching brief, CSV export
Demo mode with a fictional 20-driver fleet
Phone layout with bottom bar and full-screen detail
